checks.name: One screen, two players: the move-in panel introduces the mission; each half shows its player’s card in their own keys with a ring at their end; taking an end and lifting move each card on, and a gold ring shows where to go

cards: MOVING DAY · STEP 3 OF 5 In through the gate Walk together to the gold ring. The sofa stays between you. Press E again to set it down.
MOVING DAY · STEP 3 OF 5 In through the gate Walk together to the gold ring. The sofa stays between you. Press Enter again to set it down.

checks.name: One screen, two players: the card and the gold ring follow the carried sofa from the street to the door; set down halfway, both cards ask to pick it up again

info.afterSettingDown: MOVING DAY · STEP 1 OF 5 Pick it up again Walk with W A S D to the blue ring by the sofa, then press E .

checks.name: With a companion: only the player’s view has a card; the companion takes the other end; the card goes through the gate, the courtyard, the passage and the door; "It is in" says what was learned; then the card and the rings are gone

info.companionLine: MOVING DAY · STEP 1 OF 5 Take an end Press E to take this end.

checks.name: Tips during the carry: pushing into a wall without the sofa moving, heading for the stairs side of the courtyard and fifteen seconds without getting closer each bring a short tip, which goes again after six seconds

info.wall: set it down. Caught on a wall? Step back together, then turn: the sofa swings between you.
info.east: Your door is the other way: left, through the narrow passage.

checks.name: Each player is told their own controls: keys, a gamepad or touch, on the left or right of a shared screen, or anywhere on the screen when they play alone with a companion

touch: Drag on the left of the screen to walk to the blue ring by the sofa, then tap Act .
Drag on the right of the screen to walk to the gold ring by the sofa, then tap Act .
pad: Walk with the left stick to the blue ring by the sofa, then press A .
Walk with the left stick to the gold ring by the sofa, then press A .
key: Walk with W A S D to the blue ring by the sofa, then press E .
Walk with the arrow keys to the gold ring by the sofa, then press Enter .
info.companionTouch: Drag your thumb on the screen to walk to the blue ring by the sofa, then tap Act .

checks.name: No mission when the first-evening guidance is paused, for a household not following it, or once the sofa is in; it adds nothing to the saved household, no per-frame hook, and draws nothing from the random sequence

Two phones: each phone shows only its own player’s card; waiting for the partner, and the partner not being connected, are said plainly; both phones reach the last step together and both say what was learned

info.waiting: MOVING DAY · STEP 2 OF 5 Lift it together You have your end. It lifts when Ada takes the other one.
info.alone: MOVING DAY · STEP 2 OF 5 Lift it together Ada is not connected. The sofa needs both of you.

method: Actual game state in Node with shipped Three.js and the authored hero: the mission card as text, the rings as scene objects. Two phones on check/two-phones.cjs. Layout on phone screens is checked in check/bench-movein-v71c.cjs.
